description: This file is the main entry point of a Flutter application implementing a Tic Tac Toe game with a custom Ocean Professional style. It defines the main app widget, game page with UI components such as the game board, player selection, turn indicator, and game result banners, as well as game logic handling user moves, win/draw detection, and game reset functionality.

classes.name: TicTacToeApp
classes.description: Root widget setting up the custom theme and home page.

classes.name: GamePage
classes.description: Main widget rendering the game UI, managing game state, and user interaction.

classes.name: _GamePageState
classes.description: State class for GamePage, containing game logic, UI building, and state management.

classes.name: _ResultBanner
classes.description: Widget displaying the game result (win or draw) with custom styling.

classes.name: _ChoiceTile
classes.description: Widget for selecting X or O with visual feedback.

classes.name: _BoardCell
classes.description: Representing each cell in the Tic Tac Toe grid, with tap interaction and animation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, runs the TicTacToeApp widget.

methods.name: TicTacToeApp.<init>
methods.description: Constructs the root app widget, setting up theme, title, and home page.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method to construct the MaterialApp and theme, and initialize GamePage.

methods.name: restartGame
methods.description: Resets the game board and game status, keeping user symbol selection.

methods.name: newGameWithSelection
methods.description: Resets the game and prompts user to select symbol again.

methods.name: playAt
methods.description: Handles user move at index, updates game state, and checks for win/draw.

methods.name: _updateGameStatus
methods.description: Checks for a winning line or draw after each move.
